Metadata.title: MOAVO Habits
Metadata.description: Systems build habits, not willpower. MOAVO Habits is an AI habit coaching app that turns your small daily dots into the future you want.

items.a: MOAVO Habits is an AI-powered habit coaching app built around one question: who do you want to become? It goes beyond simply logging habits. Every day, AI coaching gives you encouragement and feedback on your actions, and your logged habits are turned into data that reveals your behavior patterns — so your habits become sustainable and you grow into the identity you're aiming for.

items.q: How is MOAVO Habits different from a regular habit tracker?
items.a: A typical habit tracker just checks whether you completed something. MOAVO Habits is designed as a habit running mate. Every time you log — with a quick note or a photo — AI coach AVO responds to your real behavior patterns with genuine comments and builds reports for you. It goes beyond leaving a checkmark: it cheers on your consistency and keeps you from giving up.

MOAVO Habits was made by JAE Dokgo, a behavior system designer. Drawing on years of designing physical spaces — retail stores, restaurants, cafeterias, offices, and hospitals — where the work was always about connecting human behavior to environment, JAE applied the same behavior-design principles to digital habit design inside the app.

Identity-based habit design is a behavioral-science approach that starts a habit not from "what should I do" but from "who do I want to become." MOAVO Habits builds this directly into the app: you define the identity you want to create, then set small daily habits tied to that identity to reach your goal.

items.q: What is AVO in MOAVO Habits?
items.a: AVO is MOAVO Habits' AI coach character — a running mate inspired by the avocado. Based on your real logged data, AVO sends personalized AI comments, provides AI behavior-analysis reports, and also appears as a home-screen widget whose expression changes with how your day is going.

items.q: How does MOAVO Habits use AI?
items.a: MOAVO Habits uses AI in two ways: (1) AI comments generated in real time each time you log a habit, and (2) AI behavior-analysis reports that study your accumulated data to show when you stay consistent and when you tend to waver.

MOAVO Habits was made for people who've given up on habits after a few days and blamed themselves, people who tried routines like a miracle morning alone and burned out, and anyone who needs consistency in exercise, studying, reading, saving, and more.

items.q: Why is MOAVO Habits good for people who've repeatedly failed at building habits?
items.a: MOAVO Habits is designed around behavioral science, not willpower. Instead of relying on discipline, it replaces it with a structured system — small logging actions, identity-based framing, an easy and fun UX, and daily AI encouragement — so building habits doesn't depend on willpower alone and you can hold on even on hard days.

MOAVO Habits has a free plan with 3 habit cards and a 7-day premium free trial. A paid subscription is $2.99 / month or $28.99 / year, which unlocks unlimited habit cards, AI comments, AI analysis reports, and data export.

items.q: Where can I download MOAVO Habits?
items.a: MOAVO Habits is available on the App Store and Google Play.

items.q: How do I request a refund?
items.a: In general, all in-app purchases are non-refundable, and we don't provide refunds for the remaining subscription period.

moavo.headline:
MOAVO Habits started from one belief:

habits are built through systems, not willpower.
moavo.body:
Most people don't fail at habits because they're lazy. They fail because they haven't had a system simple enough to use even after a hard day. MOAVO Habits is that simple system.

One daily log, one dot, and a gentle nudge every day from your AI running mate, AVO.
moavo.belief: We believe that even the smallest action can change you when you give it your care and attention. Change brings small wins. Over time, those wins build the momentum to take you further than you imagined.
moavo.slogan: Small actions. Small wins. Real momentum.

founder.headline:
Architect of MOAVO Habits

JAE Dokgo
Behavior System Designer
founder.body:
Before building this app, I spent years designing physical spaces — retail stores, restaurants, cafeterias, offices, even hospitals. The context was different every time, but the question was always the same:

How does the design of a space shape where people go, what they choose, and what they do?

And that experience taught me one truth: people don't change by trying harder through willpower. They change when their environment is designed so that the right action becomes the easiest choice.
founder.connector: MOAVO Habits applies that same principle to a smartphone screen instead of a floor plan.

items.subtitle: "AVO cheers you on every day"

problem.headline: Why is it so hard to build a habit?
problem.body:
Every new year, we make plans. A few days later, most of us give up. Then we blame ourselves for lacking willpower.

But here's the truth: the real problem isn't willpower. We simply never had a system to build the habit.
points: I keep meaning to do it daily, but I keep forgetting
I couldn't see my progress, so I gave up
It was too hard to keep going alone

solution.headline: MOAVO Habits is here for the future you're building
solution.body:
MOAVO Habits is more than a habit tracker. It's a proactive habit-building system grounded in behavioral science.

Log a habit, and you begin to see your actions as data. Analyze that data, and behavior patterns emerge. See your patterns, and confidence grows. And your confidence helps you change.

Day by day, small actions build momentum toward the future you want.
